title: Why GRPO Needs Normalization: A Local-Curvature Perspective on Adaptive Gradients
abstract: arXiv:2601.23135v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a key driver of language model reasoning. Among RL algorithms, Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is the de facto standard, avoiding the need for a critic by using per-prompt baselines and variance normalization. Yet why and when this normalization helps remains unclear. In this work, we answer both questions through the lens of local curvature of the sequence-level policy gradient: standard deviation normalization implements an adaptive gradient. Theoretically, we prove that under mild conditions GRPO attains an improved convergence rate over unnormalized REINFORCE, with gains characterized by the average within-prompt reward standard deviation across prompts and iterations. We further introduce IS-GRPO, an importance-sampling variant of GRPO whose expected update remains aligned with the full gradient, and prove a convergence guarantee of the same form as REINFORCE's, which is tighter i

translated_title: 为什么GRPO需要归一化：从局部曲率视角看自适应梯度
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）已成为语言模型推理能力的关键驱动力。在众多RL算法中，组相对策略优化（GRPO）是事实上的标准方法，它通过使用每个提示（prompt）的基线和方差归一化来避免对评论家（critic）网络的需求。然而，这种归一化为何有效以及何时有效仍不清楚。在本工作中，我们通过序列级策略梯度的局部曲率视角回答了这两个问题：标准差归一化实质上实现了一种自适应梯度。在理论上，我们证明在温和条件下，GRPO相比未归一化的REINFORCE获得了更优的收敛速率，其增益大小由跨提示和跨迭代的提示内平均奖励标准差来刻画。我们进一步提出了IS-GRPO，即GRPO的一种重要性采样变体，其期望更新仍与完整梯度保持对齐，并证明了其收敛保证与REINFORCE具有相同形式，且更为紧致。
tldr: 该论文从局部曲率的视角揭示了GRPO中方差归一化的本质是实现自适应梯度，证明了其相比未归一化REINFORCE的收敛速率优势，并提出了期望更新与完整梯度对齐且具有更紧致收敛保证的重要性采样变体IS-GRPO。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals from a local-curvature perspective that variance normalization in GRPO implements an adaptive gradient, proves its improved convergence rate over unnormalized REINFORCE, and introduces IS-GRPO, an importance-sampling variant whose expected update aligns with the full gradient and carries a tighter convergence guarantee.
